In dieser neu geschaffenen, zentralen Rolle im Herzen der IT übernimmst du eine Schlüsselposition für Governance und Compliance in der Softwareentwicklung. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Vorgaben nicht nur definiert sind, sondern im Alltag gelebt werden und damit einen konkreten Mehrwert für die gesamte Organisation schaffen.

Secure Coding, Kryptographie, Testing, Open-Source-Nutzung) sowie Sicherstellen der Einhaltung der übergeordneten IT-Sicherheitsvorgaben in den Bereichen Security Governance und Architektur

• Erstellen von Solution Architektur - Blueprints und aktives Begleiten der Lösungsumsetzung
• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Softwareentwicklung, IT-Architektur, IT-Security, idealerweise im Banken- oder Finanzsektor

• Erfahrung mit Code-Scanning-Tools (SAST, SCA), sowie in AI, in Prompting und AI-basierten Applikationsentwicklung von Vorteil

In questo nuovo ruolo centrale creato nel cuore dell'IT, si assumerà una posizione chiave per la governance e la conformità nello sviluppo del software. Assicurarsi che le nostre specifiche non sono solo definite, ma sono vissute nella vita quotidiana e quindi creare valore aggiunto concreto per l'intera organizzazione.

• Creating Solution Architecture - Blueprints e implementazione di soluzioni attivamente accompagnanti

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale in uno o più dei seguenti settori: sviluppo software, architettura IT, sicurezza IT, idealmente nel settore bancario o finanziario

• Esperienza con strumenti di scansione del codice (SAST, SCA), così come in AI, sollecitazione e sviluppo di applicazioni basate su AI
• Forte capacità analitiche e concettuali per penetrare questioni complesse
• Alta forza di comunicazione, persuasione e la necessaria assertività a rappresentare anche decisioni spiacevoli

As a modern and future-oriented bank, we attach the highest importance to the security, stability and quality of our IT systems. In order to ensure consistent compliance with our high standards in software development and to protect our application landscape from risks, we are creating this new, central key position at the heart of our IT.

In this newly created central role at the heart of IT, you will assume a key position for governance and compliance in software development. You ensure that our specifications are not only defined, but are lived in everyday life and thus create concrete added value for the entire organization.

Your tasks

• Formation of control functions by setting up an application that checks the specifications in software development as automatically as possible
• Perform regular checks and reviews to comply with internal developer guidelines (e.g. secure coding, cryptography, testing, open source use) and ensure compliance with the higher-level IT security requirements in the areas of security governance and architecture
• Provision of deviations and findings via APIs for further processing in the risk department
• Close cooperation with the departments and committees that define higher-level requirements, derive new or adapted requirements from them and contribute to the further development and sharpening of these requirements with your practical relevance
• Support the "Exception to Policy" (ETP) process for the respective department with the overarching specifications
• Creating Solution Architecture - Blueprints and actively accompanying solution implementation
• Completed degree in computer science, business informatics or a comparable qualification
• Several years of professional experience in one or more of the following areas: software development, IT architecture, IT security, ideally in the banking or financial sector
• In-depth knowledge of fullstack development (Java, Angular), as well as a deep understanding of modern software development processes (CI/CD, DevSecOps) and architectures
• Experience with code scanning tools (SAST, SCA), as well as in AI, prompting and AI-based application development
• Strong analytical and conceptual skills to penetrate complex issues
• High communication strength, persuasion and the necessary assertiveness to represent even unpleasant decisions
• An independent, structured and very responsible way of working with a high degree of integrity and objectivity
• Flowing German and good English skills
• Motivated, self-organized and established team that looks forward to you
• Exciting and diverse range of tasks with many network possibilities
• We count on your ideas and offer you space for your impulses
• Various opportunities to develop personally and professionally
• Modern workplace in district 5 with very good transport connections (hard bridge station)

• Various events and internal networks offer you the opportunity to network quickly
• Comprehensive package, which in addition to the attractive basic salary and a variable remuneration offers many benefits and perks – from A such as retirement provision to Z such as ZVV bonus pass
